purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0258 in the gauge arena: the Clifford register gives the model exact chirality and P and CP violation, partial (C is kept, so no asymmetry yet): right multiplication by the volume element splits Cl+(4) into two halves that commute with every piece of E-SPN-0160 and that W(F4) keeps under its 576 rotations and swaps under its 576 reflections, so the member space is two mirror species; W+(F4) has W(F4)'s invariants in every degree below 24 (Molien), so a rule covariant under the rotations only is exactly as isotropic, and the husk parity that keeps depth (the cusp fixes it) is the reflection; a chiral mass (u on one half, another unit on the other) is exact over Z[w][1/42] and keeps gamma = 0, c/4, R = tan m/m, isotropy and every channel census closed (mixed pairs at 2 M-), breaks P and CP and keeps C, P under -I and CPT; a phase on one conserved half is removed by rephasing; the frames cannot be three generations (their stabilizer has three quartic invariants), and the ring holds the trimaximal mixing exactly, with the maximal Jarlskog invariant sqrt(3)/18.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
